items.name: Sri Yantra
items.material: Gold, Silver, Copper, or drawn on paper with red or sandalwood paste
items.placement: East or North facing, ideally in the puja room
items.activation: Friday, during Shukla Paksha, or on full moon day
benefits: Attainment of extreme wealth and prosperity
Immense spiritual power and divine energy
Complete fulfillment of all desires and wishes
Removal of all obstacles and challenges
Peace and harmony in all areas of life
items.description: The Sri Yantra is the most powerful and revered yantra in Hindu tradition, representing the cosmic form of Goddess Tripura Sundari (Lalita). It consists of 9 interlocking triangles - 5 pointing downward (Shakti) and 4 pointing upward (Shiva), forming 43 smaller triangles. At its center is the Bindu (point), representing the supreme consciousness. The Sri Yantra is considered the mother of all yantras and is used for the highest spiritual practices. Worshipping the Sri Yantra is believed to bring all prosperity, spiritual power, and ultimate liberation.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East or North. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and flowers. Chant the Sri Vidya mantra (Om Shreem Hreem Kleem Aim Sauh) 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.
items.chakra_activation: All chakras, especially Anahata, Vishuddhi, Ajna, and Sahasrara

items.name: Shree Yantra
items.material: Gold, Silver, Copper, or drawn on paper
items.placement: East or North East, in the puja room or safe
items.activation: Friday, during Pradosh Kaal, or on Diwali
benefits: Attraction of immense wealth and prosperity
Abundance in all areas of life
Removal of poverty and financial struggles
Peace and harmony in the family
items.description: The Shree Yantra is a sacred geometric diagram representing Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. It is a powerful tool for attracting wealth, financial success, and abundance. The yantra consists of a central point surrounded by various geometric shapes and lotus petals, each representing different aspects of prosperity. Worshipping the Shree Yantra is believed to remove all financial obstacles and bring continuous wealth and prosperity.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East or North East. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and flowers. Chant the Lakshmi mantra (Om Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah) 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.

items.name: Kuber Yantra
items.material: Gold or Copper, or drawn on paper with yellow color
items.placement: North or East, in the safe or cash box
items.activation: Dhanteras or Friday, during Pradosh Kaal
benefits: Attraction of immense wealth and treasure
Abundance in all areas of life
Removal of poverty and financial struggles
items.description: The Kuber Yantra is a powerful yantra dedicated to Lord Kuber, the treasurer of the gods and the lord of wealth. This yantra is used for attracting wealth, protecting assets, and ensuring financial growth. The yantra consists of geometric patterns that represent Kuber's divine energy and his power to bestow wealth. Worshipping the Kuber Yantra is believed to bring immense wealth, financial stability, and protection of assets.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing North or East. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and flowers. Chant the Kuber mantra (Om Yakshaya Kuberaya Namah) 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.

items.name: Baglamukhi Yantra
items.purpose: Victory over enemies, legal success, protection
items.material: Gold, Copper, or drawn on paper with yellow color
items.placement: East or North, in the puja room or office
items.activation: Tuesday, during Hora of Mars, or during legal proceedings
benefits: Success in legal matters and court cases
items.description: The Baglamukhi Yantra is a powerful yantra dedicated to Goddess Baglamukhi, the goddess who paralyzes enemies and grants victory. This yantra is used for protection, victory over enemies, and success in legal matters. The yantra consists of geometric patterns that represent Baglamukhi's fierce energy and her power to defeat enemies. Worshipping the Baglamukhi Yantra is believed to grant complete victory over enemies, success in legal matters, and powerful protection.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East or North. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and yellow flowers. Chant the Baglamukhi mantra 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.

items.name: Mahamrityunjaya Yantra
items.material: Silver, Copper, or drawn on paper with white color
items.placement: East, in the puja room or near the sick person
items.activation: Monday, during Brahma Muhurat, or during illness
benefits: Excellent health and healing from all diseases
Protection from accidents and untimely death
Removal of all fears and anxieties
Peace of mind and mental strength
items.description: The Mahamrityunjaya Yantra is a powerful yantra dedicated to Lord Shiva in his Mahamrityunjaya form. This yantra is used for health, longevity, and protection from untimely death. The yantra consists of geometric patterns that represent Shiva's healing energy and his power over death. Worshipping the Mahamrityunjaya Yantra is believed to heal all diseases, grant long life, and protect from all dangers.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and water. Chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.

items.name: Ganesh Yantra
items.material: Copper, Brass, or drawn on paper with red color
items.placement: East or North East, in the puja room or workplace
items.activation: Wednesday, during Brahma Muhurat, or before starting new work
benefits: Complete removal of all obstacles and impediments
Attainment of success in all endeavors
Powerful protection from all negative forces
items.description: The Ganesh Yantra is a sacred yantra dedicated to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles and the lord of beginnings. This yantra is used for removing all obstacles and ensuring success in all endeavors. The yantra consists of geometric patterns that represent Ganesha's divine energy and his power to remove obstacles. Worshipping the Ganesh Yantra is believed to remove all obstacles, grant success, and bring wisdom and prosperity.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East or North East. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and modak. Chant the Ganesha mantra (Om Gam Ganapataye Namah) 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.
items.chakra_activation: Muladhara (Root), Manipura (Solar Plexus), and Ajna (Third Eye)

items.name: Navagraha Yantra
items.material: Copper, Panchadhatu (five metals), or drawn on paper
items.placement: East, in the puja room or central area
items.activation: Sunday, during sunrise, or any auspicious planetary hour
benefits: Removal of all planetary doshas and afflictions
items.description: The Navagraha Yantra is a combined yantra of all nine planets - Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budha, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, and Ketu. This yantra is used for balancing planetary energies and removing all planetary doshas. The yantra consists of geometric patterns representing each planet in their respective positions. Worshipping the Navagraha Yantra is believed to balance planetary energies, remove all afflictions, and bring success and harmony.
items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and flowers. Chant the Navagraha mantra 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.

items.procedure: Place the yantra in a clean place facing East or North. Perform a small puja with incense, lamp, and red flowers. Chant the Durga mantra (Om Dum Durgayai Namah) 108 times. Meditate on the yantra's form.
